hook.text: Which jumps close into a shape?

text.formula: Jump ¼ of a turn: a square
Jump 2/5 of a turn: a star
Jump by the golden ratio: it never closes

youtube.title: Fractions draw stars, the golden ratio never closes ⭐ #shorts
youtube.description:
A point jumps the same fraction of a turn again and again. A simple fraction like 1/4 or 2/5 closes into a shape; the golden ratio never lands on the same spot twice.

hook.text: What does gravity do to a bounce?

youtube.title: Straight lines, then gravity bends them 🏀 #shorts
youtube.description:
Without gravity a ball travels in straight lines. With gravity every flight becomes a parabola. Speed it up a little on every bounce and the path turns chaotic.

youtube.title: Doubling: 1 ball becomes 128 in seconds 🟢 #shorts

Every time a ball bounces it splits in two. 1, 2, 4, 8 … after seven doublings there are 128. That is exponential growth.

hook.text: Why do the notes get faster?

text.formula: Every bounce makes it a little bigger
Bigger ball: shorter trips, faster notes
With gravity, until it fills the circle

youtube.title: A ball that grows on every bounce 🟠 #shorts
youtube.description:
The ball grows a little each time it hits the circle. The bigger it gets, the shorter its trip across, so the bounces (and the notes) come faster and faster.
